items.title: 🇰🇭 CAMBODIA — TWO GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES ALLEGEDLY BREACHED
items.body:
🇰🇭 CAMBODIA — TWO GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES ALLEGEDLY BREACHED

A threat actor claims to have compromised two Cambodian ministries: the Ministry of Environment (http://moe.gov.kh) and the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology & Innovation (MISTI).

The posts claim:
• MoE: WAF bypass, exposed debug logs and admin panels, and 11.8 MB of extracted portal data, including user and content dumps
• MISTI: a database with about 2,500 records holding usernames and passwords
• Both posts went up within minutes of each other from the same new forum account

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Leaked government portal credentials and admin paths make follow-on intrusion and phishing against ministry staff easier. These are unverified threat-actor claims, not confirmation of a breach.

items.body:
🚨 🇰🇭 Alleged Data Breach at Cambodia’s Ministry of Interior

A Dark Web forum user operating under the alias DaOnlySpark claims to have compromised Cambodia’s Ministry of Interior and is offering the allegedly obtained data for sale. The post describes exposure of personnel records, system user accounts, attached identity and family documents, and backups containing source code and database dumps for the ministry’s Sport Council system.

🏢 Affected Organization: Ministry of Interior of Cambodia

items.title: 🚨🇰🇭 Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology and Institute of Digital Technology allegedly breached, sensitive files leaked
items.body:
🚨🇰🇭 Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology and Institute of Digital Technology allegedly breached, sensitive files leaked

The actor "DaOnlySpark" has released a second batch of files allegedly stolen from Cambodia's Academy of Digital Technology (CADT) and Institute of Digital Technology (IDT).

The actor says they exploited a remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability to access internal systems, obtaining SQL databases, application source code, employee documents, student records, and payment information.

The leak also reportedly contains sensitive credentials, including Microsoft 365, Google, OpenAI, and payment API credentials, along with SSH keys, OAuth secrets, and Firebase service account keys.

items.title: A chilling look inside an abandoned scammer compound on the Thai-Cambodia border.
items.body:
A chilling look inside an abandoned scammer compound on the Thai-Cambodia border. 

What looks like a normal housing development is actually a high-security complex used to defraud victims worldwide, complete with scam scripts, lists of targets, torture rooms, and even a themed brothel.

Worse yet? Construction on the site was ongoing, suggesting the operation was only getting started.

#ScamCompound #CyberCrime #Investigation #ThaiCambodiaBorde #DDW

items.body:
🚨🇰🇭 A threat actor known as spark is distributing a dataset allegedly tied to the Ministry of Commerce of the Kingdom of Cambodia, claiming roughly 2.1K leaked records.

Allegedly exposed data includes:

• Display names and full names (first / last)
• Government email addresses (@moc.gov.kh) and aliases
• Department, office, and organizational unit
• Job titles and roles (incl. director-level positions)
• Mailbox type, recipient type, and Exchange/mailbox policies
• Phone numbers and postal codes
• Country/region and state/province
• Archive, retention, and sharing policy details
• Last-modified timestamps and custom attribute fields

Claim is unverified.

🇰🇭 Cambodia – National Employment Agency (NEA) Data Leak Claim

A threat actor claims to have breached the National Employment Agency (NEA) of Cambodia and is offering internal data for download.

📊 Key Details:
• Target: NEA (http://nea.gov.kh)
• Country: Cambodia 🇰🇭
• Actor: 0xLei
• Type: Government / Employment Services

📂 Alleged Data Includes:
• Application storage (logs, cached & temporary files)
• Backend dependency libraries
• Database schema & migration files
• Configuration files
• Application source code

🧠 Threat Intelligence Insight:
• Exposure of source code + configs can lead to:

Discovery of hidden vulnerabilities
Credential / API key leakage
Full system compromise in follow-on attacks

• Schema + logs indicate potential deep access, not just surface data

items.body:
🇰🇭 Cambodia, 🇲🇲 Myanmar, 🇱🇦 Laos - Kasikornbank PCL (KBank)

Kasikornbank PCL (KBank), a leading Thai bank with significant operations and branches in Cambodia, Myanmar, and Laos, has allegedly suffered a data breach. Information concerning customers from these three countries is reportedly being offered for sale on a dark web forum. The alleged data, extracted in January 2026, appears to be creditor data, indicating a potential compromise of financial client information. KBank operates a locally incorporated institution in Laos named KASIKORNTHAI BANK LIMITED, with a head office in Vientiane Capital. It also has a branch in Phnom Penh, Cambodia, and a representative office in Yangon, Myanmar.
